canonical_goal: Add server-side ExAIS expert conversation sessions so caller agents can ask a named vector-store expert in natural language while ExAIS owns retrieval, graph use, citations, memory, feedback, tenancy, and provider-agnostic LLM execution.

tickets.title: Define expert profile registry
tickets.goal: Create the registry contract that binds a named ExAIS expert to allowed vector stores, prompts, graph lenses, citation policy, answer caveats, model policy, and tool limits.
tickets.acceptance: Expert profiles can be listed and resolved under the request principal; invalid or cross-scope store bindings fail closed before any retrieval or LLM call.

tickets.title: Persist expert sessions and forks
tickets.goal: Add tenant-scoped persistence for expert sessions, messages, tool calls, retrieval runs, memory events, feedback, and session forks.
tickets.acceptance: Sessions are keyed by principal plus expert plus caller-provided user/conversation identifiers; resume and fork preserve audit history without crossing tenant, business-instance, or API-key boundaries.

tickets.title: Add provider-agnostic expert LLM client
tickets.goal: Introduce an internal chat/generation client abstraction for expert reasoning that can route to multiple providers and models without coupling expert behavior to one SDK.
tickets.acceptance: Expert code calls one internal client contract; provider/model selection is policy-driven, observable, testable with fixtures, and separate from embedding/rerank provider code.

tickets.title: Implement expert message API
tickets.goal: Add the caller-facing route for natural-language expert requests and return a cited answer, retrieval trace, session identifiers, model metadata, caveats, and follow-up affordances.
tickets.acceptance: `POST /v1/experts/{expert_id}/messages` requires bearer auth, `retrieval:read`, and a valid expert profile; it returns typed OpenAPI components and never exposes raw backend credentials or storage internals.

tickets.title: Wire expert retrieval planner
tickets.goal: Create the server-side expert tool loop that turns natural language into scoped semantic searches, graph-lens searches, citation expansion, and answer synthesis.
tickets.acceptance: The expert engine can call existing vector-store search and graph-lens code, records every retrieval run, applies citation integrity/output guard behavior, and does not alter default raw search behavior.

tickets.title: Govern expert memory and feedback
tickets.goal: Add strict memory and feedback rules so caller corrections can improve future expert behavior without becoming authoritative law or leaking between users.
tickets.acceptance: Feedback is stored as scoped evidence about interaction quality; promoted memory is opt-in, typed, confidence-scored, deletable, audit-visible, and excluded from legal-source citations unless backed by retrieved source material.

tickets.title: Document caller MCP contract and evals
tickets.goal: Document the thin caller-side MCP/tooling contract and add an eval harness that compares raw search against expert-session answers for store-specific tough queries.
tickets.acceptance: Caller docs define `list_exais_experts`, `ask_exais_expert`, and `submit_expert_feedback`; tests prove expert answers preserve citations and beat or match raw search on selected legal/civics evals.
